extraction.text:
SUDHIR DOOMRA

+91 8427991098 ⋄ Gurgaon, Haryana, India sdoomra76@gmail.com ⋄ linkedin.com/in/sudhir-doomra

EXPERIENCE

Senior Software Developer - Netcracker Technology	Oct 2024 - Present

Worked on the O2 UK telecom operator project, where I contributed to enhancing core telecom product functionalities using Java, Spring Boot, and MySQL.Played a key role in simplifying and automating order management processes, resulting in faster order handling and reduced manual effort.

Resolved critical production issues, optimized SQL queries, and developed new features within existing microser- vices to align with evolving business requirements and improve overall system efficiency.

Senior Software Developer - BNY Mellon Technology	Mar 2020 - Oct 2024

Wrote a Restful API to replace the legacy framework, resulting in a 30% reduction in response time. The API efficiently computed PDF Byte arrays based on business requirements, enhancing system reliability by reducing error rates by 15%.

Enhanced the form configuration management tool by introducing user-friendly features, resulting in a 30% increase in user engagement and a 20% decrease in support tickets related to form management.

Automated broker dealer forms generation with frontend customization via JSP tree, slashing manual effort and

accelerating onboarding by 40%

Guiding 2 interns for easy induction to team and applications.

Implemented AWS S3, facilitating seamless data storage, retrieval, and management in cloud-based environments resulting in 20% increase in data accessibility and reliability.

Designing, developing, testing, maintaining software systems and collaborating with team members and stake- holders to design and implement scalable solutions, ensuring code quality through regular reviews and testing

Software Developer - BNY Mellon Technology	Jul 2017 - Mar 2020

Enhanced client onboarding experience by spearheading the design and development of an innovative account bundling feature resulted in a 25% reduction in onboarding time.

Mitigated security risks by 30% through targeted fixes and upgrades of vulnerable JARs within team applications.

Contributed to fixing the reported bugs in Production which resulted in 90% reduction in the tickets related to the feature.

Replacing legacy APIs with new REST APIs in existing applications to reduce the response time by 25%.

Software Developer Intern - BNY Mellon Technology	Jan 2017 - Jun 2017

Designed and implemented a comprehensive online bus booking application, leveraging Java for backend logic, JSP for web page rendering, and Servlets for handling HTTP requests and managing user interactions.

SKILLS

Languages	Java, JavaScript, SQL, HTML, CSS

Frameworks/Platforms	Spring Boot, Microservices, JUnit, Angular 16, Docker, Kubernetes, AWS

Soft Skills	Teamwork, Supervision, Management

EDUCATION

Bachelor of Technology, Chitkara University	Jul 2013 - May 2017 Computer Science and Engineering

PROJECTS



Form Management Center for Broker Dealer The purpose of this application is to provide an elegant and simple interface to present the broker dealer forms for various transactions and streamline the process to search and download the forms. Technology : Java, Angular, Spring Boot, MySQL, Microservices.

Account Opening with Funding and e-signature Directed the creation of an account opening platform, integrating funding functionalities and e-signature capabilities. Oversaw the implementation of features en- abling clients to sign paperwork using both wet signatures and e-signatures. Leveraged Java and Spring Boot technologies for seamless execution.

Online Forms Generation Architected a robust microservices-based solution to generate pre-filled new account forms in PDF format, leveraging MySQL database, reduced manual form filling time by 50% and accelerated client onboarding process by 60% Technology : Java, Spring Boot, Microservices, AWS
